scenes.title: The Sad Little Bear
scenes.body: The little fox was playing in the sunny meadow when she saw a small bear sitting by a tree. The bear's head was down and his eyes were shiny with tears. The fox trotted over and asked, 'What is the matter?' The bear sniffled, 'I can't find my little red ball anywhere.' The fox sat beside him and said, 'I will help you find it.'
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Finding the Red Ball
scenes.body: Together they looked behind the bushes and under the flowers. They walked down the path to the old oak tree. There, tucked in the grass, was the little red ball! The bear gasped and ran to pick it up. He hugged the ball and laughed, 'You found it! Thank you, friend!'
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Best Friends
scenes.body: From then on, the fox and the bear played together every day. The bear learned that a friend who listens when you are sad is a treasure. And whenever someone felt lost, they would remember how good it felt to help. Helping makes hearts happy, and that is the truest magic of all.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about empathy.
